svg.title: Fig. 86(b) — The graph of y = (1 + x)^{1/x}
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 86(b), page 93. Section: exponential.

g.data-text: The axes, the asymptote y = 1 (the value as x → ∞) and the line x = −1.
For x > −1 the curve falls from +∞ at the line x = −1 through the open point (0, e) towards the asymptote y = 1.
For x < −1 the base 1 + x is negative; the points that exist lie on the dotted curves y = ±|1 + x|^{1/x}, which run to ±∞ at the line x = −1.
